unitTitle: Reported Speech - Reported Statements - Say/Tell - Reported Questions

pairsWith.noteUz: Ko'chirma savollar: Ex.5 davomi, Kenji savollari, reportyor savollari, suratli aralash mashq.

scanNote:
GRAMMAR 2, 14-UNIT MAShQLAR, 3-BET (69-bet, PDF 68). Yuqorida o'ngda ko'k '14'.

CHAP USTUN:
5) davomi: 5 "Where are you going?" Father asked. 6 "How tall are you?" Ian asked me. 7 Eve asked, "Did you buy any bread?" 8 "Is Sheila your best friend?" he asked.
6) 'Bob is having a birthday party next Saturday. His friend Kenji wants to know more about it and has asked him some questions. Report Tom's questions.' (⚠ kitobda 'Tom's' - matn xatosi, Kenji nazarda tutilgan). SURAT: qizil sviterdagi kulib turgan yigit, atrofida gap bulutlari: 1 How many people have you invited? 2 What time will the party begin? 3 Who is doing the cooking? 4 What sort of music will you play? 5 Did you order a birthday cake? Javob qatorlari: 1 Kenji asked him ... 2 He wanted to know ... 3 Kenji asked him ... 4 Kenji wanted to know ... 5 He also asked him ...
7) 'There has been a car accident on your street. Read the reporter's questions and turn them into reported speech, as in the example.' 1 "How did the accident happen?" The reporter asked how the accident had happened. 2 "What time did the accident take place?" The reporter asked ... 3 "Who called the police?" The reporter wanted to know ... 4 "Was anybody hurt?" The reporter asked ... 5 "How many cars were involved?" The reporter wanted to know ...

O'NG USTUN - 'Reported Statements and Questions':
8) 'Read what these people said and write each statement or question in reported speech.' 6 SURAT: 1 ona va kulayotgan qizcha kitob o'qishyapti - "Why is the princess laughing?" The little girl asked her mother ...; 2 telefonda gaplashayotgan xavotirli erkak - "I forgot we had a meeting today." He told me ...; 3 tez yordam, o'tirgan bola - "Are you OK?" They asked her ...; 4 chaqaloq ko'targan ayol telefonda - "I'll be there around 11:00." Mary told her boss ...; 5 rasm chizayotgan bolalar - "What have you drawn?" Rick asked Lucy ...; 6 poyga g'oliblari (ayol va keksa erkak) - "We won the race." They told us ...

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '69'.

exercises.instructionEn: Turn the questions from direct into reported speech (continued). 5 'Where are you going?' Father asked. 6 'How tall are you?' Ian asked me. 7 Eve asked, 'Did you buy any bread?' 8 'Is Sheila your best friend?' he asked.
exercises.instructionUz: Savollarni ko'chirma gapga aylantiring (davomi). 5 'Qayerga ketyapsan?' deb so'radi dadam. 6 'Bo'ying qancha?' deb so'radi Ian mendan. 7 Iv so'radi: 'Non sotib oldingmi?' 8 'Sheyla eng yaqin do'stingmi?' deb so'radi u.
exercises.explanationUz:
5 Where are you going → where I
    was going
  6 How tall are you → how tall I
    was
  7 Did you buy → if I had bought
  8 Is Sheila → if Sheila was

  ⚠ Savol so'zi bo'lsa 'if' YO'Q.
  ⚠ Ha/yo'q savol → if/whether.
  ⚠ Tartib: EGA + FE'L (savol
  tartibi emas).


⚠ 'HOW TALL':

  = bo'yi qancha.
modelAnswers: 5 Father asked where I was going.
6 Ian asked me how tall I was.
7 Eve asked if/whether I had bought any bread.
8 He asked if/whether Sheila was my best friend.
modelAnswersUz: 5 Dadam qayerga ketayotganimni so'radi. (where I was going)
6 Ian mendan bo'yim qanchaligini so'radi. (how tall I was)
7 Iv non sotib olgan-olmaganimni so'radi. (if I had bought)
8 U Sheyla eng yaqin do'stim ekan-ekanmasligini so'radi. (if Sheila was)

exercises.instructionEn: Bob is having a birthday party next Saturday. His friend Kenji wants to know more about it and has asked him some questions. Report Kenji's questions. 1 How many people have you invited? → Kenji asked him ... 2 What time will the party begin? → He wanted to know ... 3 Who is doing the cooking? → Kenji asked him ... 4 What sort of music will you play? → Kenji wanted to know ... 5 Did you order a birthday cake? → He also asked him ...
exercises.instructionUz: Bob keyingi shanba tug'ilgan kun ziyofati o'tkazmoqda. Do'sti Kenji bu haqda ko'proq bilmoqchi va unga savollar berdi. Kenjining savollarini ko'chirma gapda yozing. 1 Nechta odamni taklif qilding? → Kenji undan ... so'radi 2 Ziyofat soat nechada boshlanadi? → U ... bilmoqchi bo'ldi 3 Ovqatni kim tayyorlayapti? → Kenji undan ... so'radi 4 Qanday musiqa qo'yasan? → Kenji ... bilmoqchi bo'ldi 5 Tug'ilgan kun tortini buyurtma qildingmi? → U yana undan ... so'radi
exercises.explanationUz:
KENJINING SAVOLLARI (Bobga).

  1 have you invited → he had
    invited; you → he
  2 will the party begin → the
    party would begin
  3 Who is doing → who was doing
  4 will you play → he would play
  5 Did you order → if he had
    ordered

  ⚠ Kitobda 'Report Tom's
  questions' - matn xatosi, Kenji
  nazarda tutilgan.


⚠ 'WHAT SORT OF':

  = qanday turdagi.
modelAnswers: 1 Kenji asked him how many people he had invited.
2 He wanted to know what time the party would begin.
3 Kenji asked him who was doing the cooking.
4 Kenji wanted to know what sort of music he would play.
5 He also asked him if/whether he had ordered a birthday cake.
modelAnswersUz: 1 Kenji undan nechta odamni taklif qilganini so'radi. (he had invited)
2 U ziyofat soat nechada boshlanishini bilmoqchi bo'ldi. (would begin)
3 Kenji undan ovqatni kim tayyorlayotganini so'radi. (was doing)
4 Kenji qanday musiqa qo'yishini bilmoqchi bo'ldi. (he would play)
5 U yana undan tort buyurtma qilgan-qilmaganini so'radi. (if he had ordered)

exercises.instructionEn: There has been a car accident on your street. Read the reporter's questions and turn them into reported speech, as in the example. 1 'How did the accident happen?' → The reporter asked how the accident had happened. 2 'What time did the accident take place?' → The reporter asked ... 3 'Who called the police?' → The reporter wanted to know ... 4 'Was anybody hurt?' → The reporter asked ... 5 'How many cars were involved?' → The reporter wanted to know ...
exercises.instructionUz: Ko'changizda avtohalokat bo'ldi. Muxbirning savollarini o'qing va ularni ko'chirma gapga aylantiring, namunadagidek. 1 'Halokat qanday sodir bo'ldi?' → Muxbir halokat qanday sodir bo'lganini so'radi. 2 'Halokat soat nechada bo'ldi?' → Muxbir ... so'radi 3 'Politsiyani kim chaqirdi?' → Muxbir ... bilmoqchi bo'ldi 4 'Kimdir jarohat oldimi?' → Muxbir ... so'radi 5 'Nechta mashina ishtirok etdi?' → Muxbir ... bilmoqchi bo'ldi
exercises.explanationUz:
O'TGAN ZAMON → PAST PERFECT.

  1 did happen → had happened
    (NAMUNA)
  2 did take place → had taken
    place
  3 Who called → who had called
  4 Was anybody hurt → if anybody
    had been hurt
  5 were involved → had been
    involved

  ⚠ 'take place' = sodir bo'lmoq.
  ⚠ 'be involved' = ishtirok etmoq
  (passiv).
exercises.exampleEn: 1 The reporter asked how the accident had happened.
exercises.exampleUz: 1 Muxbir halokat qanday sodir bo'lganini so'radi.
modelAnswers: 1 The reporter asked how the accident had happened.
2 The reporter asked what time the accident had taken place.
3 The reporter wanted to know who had called the police.
4 The reporter asked if/whether anybody had been hurt.
5 The reporter wanted to know how many cars had been involved.
modelAnswersUz: 1 Muxbir halokat qanday sodir bo'lganini so'radi. (NAMUNA)
2 Muxbir halokat soat nechada sodir bo'lganini so'radi. (had taken place)
3 Muxbir politsiyani kim chaqirganini bilmoqchi bo'ldi. (had called)
4 Muxbir kimdir jarohat olgan-olmaganini so'radi. (if anybody had been hurt)
5 Muxbir nechta mashina ishtirok etganini bilmoqchi bo'ldi. (had been involved)

exercises.instructionEn: Read what these people said and write each statement or question in reported speech. 1 'Why is the princess laughing?' The little girl asked her mother ... 2 'I forgot we had a meeting today.' He told me ... 3 'Are you OK?' They asked her ... 4 'I'll be there around 11:00.' Mary told her boss ... 5 'What have you drawn?' Rick asked Lucy ... 6 'We won the race.' They told us ...
exercises.instructionUz: Bu odamlar nima deganini o'qing va har bir darak gap yoki savolni ko'chirma gapda yozing. 1 'Malika nega kulyapti?' Qizcha onasidan ... so'radi 2 'Bugun yig'ilishimiz borligini unutibman.' U menga ... dedi 3 'Yaxshimisan?' Ular undan ... so'rashdi 4 'Soat 11 atrofida u yerda bo'laman.' Meri boshlig'iga ... dedi 5 'Nima chizding?' Rik Lyusidan ... so'radi 6 'Biz poygada yutdik.' Ular bizga ... deyishdi
exercises.explanationUz:
ARALASh: DARAK + SAVOL.

  1 SAVOL: is laughing → was
    laughing
  2 DARAK: forgot → had forgotten;
    had → had (had a meeting - had
    qoladi); today → that day
  3 SAVOL: Are you OK → if she was
    OK
  4 DARAK: 'll be → would be
  5 SAVOL: have you drawn → she had
    drawn
  6 DARAK: won → had won

  ⚠ 2-gapda 'we had a meeting'
  o'tgan zamon, 'had' ko'chirmada
  'had had' bo'lishi mumkin, lekin
  'they had a meeting' ham qabul
  qilinadi.


⚠ 'A PRINCESS':

  = malika.
modelAnswers: 1 The little girl asked her mother why the princess was laughing.
2 He told me that he had forgotten they had a meeting that day.
3 They asked her if/whether she was OK.
4 Mary told her boss that she would be there around 11:00.
5 Rick asked Lucy what she had drawn.
6 They told us that they had won the race.
modelAnswersUz: 1 Qizcha onasidan malika nega kulayotganini so'radi. (was laughing)
2 U menga o'sha kuni yig'ilishlari borligini unutganini aytdi. (had forgotten)
3 Ular undan yaxshimi-yo'qligini so'rashdi. (if she was OK)
4 Meri boshlig'iga soat 11 atrofida u yerda bo'lishini aytdi. (would be)
5 Rik Lyusidan nima chizganini so'radi. (she had drawn)
6 Ular bizga poygada yutganlarini aytishdi. (had won)

patterns.formula: KIM + asked + (KIMDAN) + SAVOL SO'ZI + EGA + O'TGAN ZAMON
patterns.exampleEn: Father asked where I was going. The reporter asked how the accident had happened.
patterns.exampleUz: Dadam qayerga ketayotganimni so'radi. Muxbir halokat qanday sodir bo'lganini so'radi.

patterns.formula: KIM + asked + (KIMDAN) + if/whether + EGA + O'TGAN ZAMON
patterns.exampleEn: Eve asked if I had bought any bread. They asked her if she was OK.
patterns.exampleUz: Iv non sotib olgan-olmaganimni so'radi. Ular undan yaxshimi-yo'qligini so'rashdi.

patterns.formula: KIM + wanted to know + SAVOL SO'ZI / if + EGA + FE'L
patterns.exampleEn: He wanted to know what time the party would begin.
patterns.exampleUz: U ziyofat soat nechada boshlanishini bilmoqchi bo'ldi.
